name: dwg-field
description: DWG-Field: open AutoCAD DWG and DXF drawings on Android, iPhone and the web.

scripts.test: node web/build.mjs && node tools/test-viewer.mjs && node tools/test-plus.mjs
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.icons: node tools/make-icons.mjs && npx capacitor-assets generate --android --ios && node tools/make-plus-icons.mjs
